remarks:
Space is the first thing you'll notice in this totally remodeled sprawling ranch, where every room lives large.

Step inside to a vaulted great room with a big picture window, flexible enough for a full dining area plus a separate sitting space. To the right, the eat-in kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, generous counters, recessed lighting, a built-in dishwasher and microwave, and a pendant-lit peninsula with seating for four overlooking the living area.

A private hallway off the kitchen leads to three well-sized bedrooms and a new full bath with ceramic tile tub and shower.

On the opposite side of the home, the primary suite was created by combining two rooms and delivers true privacy: dual full-size closets, an all-ceramic tile en-suite bath with a four-foot vanity, and patio doors to a covered rear deck overlooking the huge backyard.

Downstairs, a large, high and dry basement is ready to be finished for even more living space. Outside, a new extra-wide driveway with turnaround, fresh landscaping, and a new front deck complete the package.

Nearly everything is new, including the furnace, water tank, drywall, plumbing, electrical, windows, doors, trim, kitchen, baths, carpet, and luxury vinyl plank flooring, giving you the ease of new construction with room to spread out.

Backed by a 3-year warranty, with select custom finishes offered at no additional cost. Move-in ready and better than new. Seller is open to contributing toward a buyer's rate buydown or closing costs.
